auth: gcloud Application Default Credentials (ADC) — run: gcloud auth application-default login
note: All tables share isocountry + signature as partition/cluster dimensions. Do not filter by recordstatus — it is an internal CDC replication field; ignore it in all queries. datastream_metadata is also a CDC replication field — ignore in business queries. For consumer queries, always filter by status = 'Active' (not recordstatus).

all_datasets.oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_d: B2C production (primary) — consumer, purchase, loyalty, campaign, care_case. DEFAULT for all B2C RCA.
all_datasets.oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-dv.space_cds_b2b_d: B2B sales AE2 (Middle East) — business customers, SAP orders, invoices, deliveries, CFS profiles. Use for B2B incidents.
B2B sales ASE1 (Southeast Asia) — same schema as ae2_dv_cds_tgt but for SEA region.
all_datasets.oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-dv.space_cds_b2c_d: B2C DV AE2 — data vault replica of B2C for AE2. Same tables as primary dataset.
B2C DV ASE1 — data vault replica of B2C for SEA. Same schema as primary; adds survey_qna, survey, product_hierarchy_map.
POC/test dataset — not for production RCA use.

key_identifiers.lucid: L'Oréal Universal Consumer ID (15 chars) — primary B2C consumer key linking consumer_pii, purchase, external_system_ids, consumer_behaviour, care_case
key_identifiers.consumerkey: Internal BQ surrogate key for a B2C consumer record — used in consumer_* child tables
key_identifiers.purchasekey: Internal BQ surrogate key for a B2C order — links purchase to purchase_item, shipment, survey
key_identifiers.sourceordernumber: External order number from source system — appears in incident text; look up in purchase (B2C) or sales_order.sourceorderid (B2B)
key_identifiers.ean: European Article Number — use product.ean (B2C) or sales_order_line.eancode (B2B) for product lookup
key_identifiers.sourceconsumerid: External system consumer ID — use external_system_ids to resolve to lucid (B2C)
key_identifiers.caseid: CRM care case ID — links care_case to survey (B2C)
key_identifiers.cfsmasterkey: B2B CFS (Customer File System) master ID — primary B2B professional contact key
key_identifiers.customerkey: B2B customer (business account) key — links customer to sales_order, invoice, delivery
key_identifiers.orderkey: B2B sales order key — links sales_order to sales_order_line, delivery, invoice
key_identifiers.saporderid: SAP order ID for B2B orders — appears in B2B incident text
key_identifiers.sapinvoiceid: SAP invoice ID for B2B invoices
key_identifiers.customercode: B2B customer code from SAP — use to look up customer in B2B dataset

common_rca_patterns.order_exists: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.purchase` WHERE sourceordernumber = '<ORDER_NUM>' AND isocountry = '<COUNTRY>') AS found
common_rca_patterns.order_state: SELECT sourceordernumber, currentstate, reasoncode, reasonmessage, orderdatetime, amountwithtax, currency FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.purchase` WHERE sourceordernumber = '<ORDER_NUM>' LIMIT 1
common_rca_patterns.order_items: SELECT pi.sourceitemid, pi.productname, pi.eancode, pi.itemstate, pi.reasoncode, pi.quantity FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.purchase_item` pi WHERE pi.sourceordernumber = '<ORDER_NUM>' ORDER BY pi.linenumber
common_rca_patterns.consumer_by_email: SELECT lucid, status, consumertype, firstname, lastname, registrationdatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.consumer_pii` WHERE email = '<EMAIL>' AND isocountry = '<COUNTRY>' AND status = 'Active' LIMIT 5
common_rca_patterns.consumer_by_lucid: SELECT lucid, status, consumertype, email, mobile, registrationdatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.consumer_pii` WHERE lucid = '<LUCID>' AND status = 'Active' LIMIT 1
common_rca_patterns.resolve_external_id: SELECT lucid, sourcesystemid, status FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.external_system_ids` WHERE sourceconsumerid = '<EXT_ID>' LIMIT 5
common_rca_patterns.product_by_ean: SELECT ean, name, type, productcategory, franchise, division FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.product` WHERE ean = '<EAN>' LIMIT 1
common_rca_patterns.shipment_status: SELECT shippingmethod, carrier, expecteddeliverydatetime, receiptdatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.shipment` WHERE sourceordernumber = '<ORDER_NUM>' LIMIT 5
common_rca_patterns.loyalty_points: SELECT sourceordernumber, currentstate, totalearnpoints, totalburnpoints, behaviourdatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.consumer_behaviour` WHERE lucid = '<LUCID>' ORDER BY behaviourdatetime DESC LIMIT 10
common_rca_patterns.care_cases_for_consumer: SELECT caseid, casenumber, status, origin, casereasonname, createddatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.care_case` WHERE lucid = '<LUCID>' ORDER BY createddatetime DESC LIMIT 10
common_rca_patterns.marketing_opt_status: SELECT key, value, sysupdatedatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.consumer_marketing_preferences` WHERE lucid = '<LUCID>' AND isocountry = '<COUNTRY>' LIMIT 20
common_rca_patterns.consumer_merge_history: SELECT lucid, oldlucid, mergedatetime FROM `oa-apmena-spacecds-ap-pd.space_cds_b2c_ds_replica_ae2_pd_public.consumer_merge` WHERE lucid = '<LUCID>' OR oldlucid = '<LUCID>' ORDER BY mergedatetime DESC LIMIT 5
